user.title: Persona of the Day
user.description: Give your voice assistant a new personality every day — today a posh Victorian ghost, tomorrow a 1940s radio announcer. Comes with 121 built-in personas, and you can add your own anytime. After setup, a notification will guide you through connecting it to your voice assistant (about 5 minutes). Ready?

abort.already_configured: Persona of the Day is already set up — there is only one persona per day.

create_entry.default: Persona of the Day is running — today's persona is already picked. Next: open Notifications (the bell at the bottom of the left sidebar) for the 5-minute guide to connecting your voice assistant.

init.title: Add personas
init.description: Paste new personas below, one per line. Get great ones by giving any AI chatbot the [persona generator prompt](https://github.com/TheSchultz/ha-persona-of-the-day/blob/main/PERSONA_GENERATOR.md). Entries are validated (max 120 characters, no brackets — rejections are explained in the system log) and duplicates are skipped automatically.
